title: Coefficient covariance preserves fixed residual experiments but misses controlled value
statement: For F=g(X)+a(X)^T V, (X,H) independent of Gaussian V and future read noise/seeds, H observes X only and controller gains no later X information, define gbar=E[g|H],C=E[a|H] and J0=E Var(g|H)+E tr Cov(a|H). Final predictor retains H; optimal continuation risk is EXACTLY J0+R_s(B,q;C(H)), with conditional public-context qualification. Residual covariance between g and a need not vanish; cross term cancels only after averaging V, so J0 is not constant residual variance at every transcript. Computing conditional means may be the original hard inference task. Separately, every fixed observation D of V independent of C, even nonlinear, has risk tr(E[CC^T] E[Cov(V|D)]); equal second moments preserve every fixed V-only experiment. Isotropic Gaussian C_G and normalized Hermite C_H share covariance I_M/M but different control distortion. This equality does NOT cover arbitrary joint U/V experiments; their stronger fixed comparator needs the distinct Hermite tensor proof.

requires: F=g(X)+a(X)^T V, finite second moments, (X,H) independent of Gaussian V and every future innovation/algorithmic coin. H observes X only and no later X information is acquired.

Final predictor retains H; continuation control is the retained-coefficient hard-q/hard-B Gaussian experiment with all informative side channels charged. Correlated public first-stage context is conditioned upon.
For separate covariance equality,D is ANY fixed observation of V independent of C, with C retained at predictor; this does not cover arbitrary mixed coefficient-source/V measurements.

costs: Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.

r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.
